GRAFT.ConfirmBulk: {label} holds {count} documents. Export a graft for every one?
GRAFT.CopiedManySkipped: Copied {count} graft(s) from {label}, {failed} skipped. See the console.
GRAFT.CopiedUnchanged: {name} is unchanged from its source, so the graft is empty.
GRAFT.DownloadedSkipped: Wrote {count} graft(s) from {label}, {failed} skipped. See the console.
GRAFT.FileRefused: Graft could not read {module}'s grafts file. Reinstalling the module usually fixes it; the console says why.
GRAFT.ImportBadAssets: That grafts.json has an assets block that is not an object keyed by handler.
GRAFT.ImportFormat: That is format {format}; this graft reads {reads}. Update graft.
GRAFT.ImportIntro: Builds a grafts.json into this world.
GRAFT.ImportNotEntries: That is not a grafts.json: it needs an entries list. Use Copy graft or Export graft to produce one.
GRAFT.ImportPlaceholder: Paste here, or choose a file below.
GRAFT.NoDocument: Graft could not identify that document.
GRAFT.NoFolder: Graft could not identify that folder.
GRAFT.OverwriteIntro: {count} document(s) this import writes are already in your world, and no import put them there. Replacing them overwrites whatever is in them now.
GRAFT.PromptAssets: Building also downloads the images and other files this content needs.
GRAFT.PromptBody:
{module} has {count} unbuilt entries.

Anything whose source cannot be found is skipped and named.
GRAFT.PromptTransforms: {transforms} will also run, and may fetch content from outside this world.
GRAFT.RedownloadIntro: {already} of the {total} files this needs are already on disk. Keep them and fetch only what changed, or download everything again?
GRAFT.SettingSuppressed: Modules whose build prompt has been declined
GRAFT.WorldOnly: Graft copies from the world, not from compendiums. Build in a world folder and copy there.
